svg.text: The vertical axis is execution order, not calendar time — the manual's timeline is dependency-ordered. Arrows show the batch each chapter needs; chapters also depend on the chapters above them. Row 17 is the contingency pause if the Gen 2 belt-upgrade kit turns up mid-run.
